scope: Independent bounded read-only map/photo orientation corroboration; no author mesh, image manipulation, camera solve, browser, Blender, source-geometry edit or current-condition certification.
map_figure_note: Derived coordinate plot, not an aerial image. Red is exact frozen 20-point local source outline. Other lines use OSM WGS84 nodes projected by local first-order metre conversion. Grey=paths/roads; blue=mapped water boundaries/centreline; brown=buildings. Labels are actual way IDs. Thin mapped paths do not by themselves establish an entrance or camera position.

observations.fact: The concavity between vertices 19,0,1,2 opens west/northwest. Northern lobe is around east -22..51, north -11..56 metres; southwest arm reaches east -60, north -65 metres. The outline is not a surveyed ground-wall or roof boundary.

The frontal concavity has a tall closed upper cantilever on image left and the lower rising wrap/rounded tip on image right. Entrance, flagpoles and gear-shaped museum sign identify the same facade across these views. Photo21052347 is a closer left-side view; 20856157 sees more of the right return. These are not independent opposite facades.

OSM current museum way206501415 remains version6. Water relation6184858 outer way414932435 is a narrow north-south waterway east of the museum; near museum its western shore is about east68..76m and its eastern shore95..103m. Lake Qingjiang relation5247929 outer way236803058 has a bay south of the museum, around north -70..-130m. No mapped water occupies the immediate west/northwest concave forecourt.

Water occupies foreground; rounded glazed lower projection sits in front of the high closed upper cantilever; external zigzag stair is image left and high cantilever is image right/back. This is a distinct waterside view, consistent with an eastern or southeastern observer and northward upper block on image right. Water and architecture constrain a sector, not exact camera coordinates.

decision.orientation_status: corroborated cardinal arrangement with explicitly estimated view direction
decision.front_outward_sector: west through northwest; source concavity outer normals span268.35 to331.19 degrees, not a measured photographic camera interval
decision.mirror_constraint: With a west/northwest exterior observer looking east/southeast, the northern high block must project image-left and southwest lower arm image-right. Do not reflect east/north coordinates or swap these lobes to match the rear photo.
decision.waterside_photo_sector: east to southeast is consistent with mapped water and high-block/stair left-right relations; exact observer position unproved

rejected_control.reason: Only this one of the nine saved Commons records has GPS fields. It is hundreds of metres away from the source and is labelled commons-desc-page, not verified camera EXIF/direction. Do not use it as calibrated camera location; no speculative correction applied.

limits: Water context and owner topology are independent geographic corroboration, not a metric reconstruction of roof curves or unobserved walls.
No architectural north-arrow plan, camera EXIF direction, measured facade points, or photogrammetric solve was found in this bounded check.
The northern lobe assignment is an explicit image/topology interpretation to review in author renders, not a surveyed structural floor plan.
